root_cause.text: The IRQ handler in `dpaa2-switch` does not validate the `if_id` extracted from the hardware status register before using it as an index into the `ethsw->ports[]` array, which can cause an out-of-bounds read because the array size is limited by `sw_attr.num_ifs`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "the IRQ handler extracts if_id from the upper 16 bits of the hardware status register and uses it to index into ethsw->ports[] without validation." The patch adds `if (if_id >= ethsw->sw_attr.num_ifs)` before accessing the array.
